g.text: Source-only marker utility and experimental panel design
Nested source-only cross-validation quantifies marker utility, redundancy and expected recoverability across measurement budgets.
Post-hoc experimental-design analysis; panels are source/stage specific and do not replace the frozen 16-gene panels used for primary analyses.
